name: singapaathai
description: Lionpath — run dev scripts from repo root or use web/ and worker/ directly

scripts.stop:dev: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');[8788,8787].forEach(p=>{try{execSync('lsof -ti :'+p+' | xargs kill 2>/dev/null',{stdio:'ignore',shell:true})}catch(e){}}); console.log('Stopped processes on 8787/8788 (if any).');"
